featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

WyreStorm Essentials HDMI cables are HDMI v1.4 certified and fully compatible with high-definition audio and video signals without loss in quality or distortion. Our HDMI cables are the ideal choice for the high-quality, reliable and affordable connection of 4K or HD devices over HDMI from 0.5m/1.6ft to 15m/49ft.

WyreStorm HDMI cables are the ideal choice in high quality, reliable and affordable connection of Full HD devices ranging from .5m/1.6ft to 15m/49ft. HDCP compliant, and compatible with CEC and ARC signals.
4K UHD and HD compatible (4K UHD not supported on 10m & 15m lengths) ?
Fully compatible with any HDMI input and output device ?
1080p: 16bit | 4K UHD: 8bit | HDR @24p: 10bit BT.2020 (4K and HDR not supported on 10m and 15m lengths)
